title: Coding tools
description: Tools to clone, build and test code: git, the GitHub command line, Node.js (current LTS) and a C compiler for packages that build native code. Pick a package manager and any languages you need.
_note: Node.js comes from the NodeSource apt repository, not from Ubuntu (Ubuntu's nodejs package is an old major). Why NodeSource and not the official tarball: it is signed and updated by apt like every other package, so the recipe needs no per-release checksum and no hand-managed PATH, and it fits the apt-only install flow. The major is 24 (Active LTS). Change node_24.x in the pre lines to move to the next LTS. The repo key is not pinned to a fingerprint yet (open item in PORTED.md).
